services.name: Private Limited Company Registration
services.card: The best structure for startups and growing businesses that plan to raise funds.
services.sub: Register your Private Limited Company online, from name approval to Certificate of Incorporation, PAN and TAN.
services.about: A Private Limited Company is a separate legal entity owned by its shareholders and run by its directors. Owners' personal assets are protected, and it is the preferred structure for investors and banks.
who: Startups that plan to raise investment
Businesses that want to add partners as shareholders
Founders who want limited liability and a strong brand image
Businesses dealing with large clients or government tenders
docs: Bank statement or electricity bill, not older than 2 months
Of the registered office, not older than 2 months
Only if the office is rented
steps: Share two proposed names and your business activity. We file the name application with MCA.
DSCs are issued and we draft the MOA, AOA and incorporation forms for signing.
We file with MCA. Your Certificate of Incorporation, DIN, PAN and TAN are issued.
services.pay: Step 1, before name application: only the govt name fee (₹1,000). Step 2, when incorporation starts: our fee, DSC and the remaining govt fees.
faq: How many people do I need?
At least 2 directors and 2 shareholders. The same 2 people can be both. At least one director must be resident in India.
How much capital is needed?
There is no minimum capital. You can start with as little as ₹1,000. Keeping authorised capital up to ₹1 lakh keeps government fees low.
Why does the cost change by state?
Each state charges its own stamp duty on the MOA and AOA. Use our cost calculator to see the exact amount for your state.

services.name: LLP Registration
services.card: For partners who want limited liability with lower yearly compliance.
services.sub: Register your Limited Liability Partnership online, with name approval, incorporation, LLP PAN and TAN. LLP Agreement drafting and Form 3 filing: ₹499 + stamp duty.
services.about: An LLP combines the flexibility of a partnership with the limited liability of a company. Partners are not personally liable for the LLP's debts, and compliance is lighter than a company.
who: Two or more people starting a business together
Professionals such as consultants, architects and agencies
Existing partnership firms that want limited liability
Businesses that don't plan to raise equity investment
get: DSC and DPIN for designated partners
LLP Agreement filing (Form 3): ₹499 + govt fee and stamp duty
docs: Bank statement, electricity or phone bill, not older than 2 months
Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence
Electricity bill, owner NOC, and rent agreement if rented
steps: Your two proposed names are filed with MCA and approval is obtained.
DSCs are issued, the incorporation form is drafted and documents are signed.
MCA processes the application. Certificate of Incorporation, LLP PAN and TAN are issued.
We draft the LLP Agreement and file it within 30 days of incorporation. ₹499 + stamp duty.
services.pay: Paid in steps. The amount for each step (our fee, govt fee, DSC) is paid just before that step starts.
faq: How many partners do I need?
At least 2 designated partners, and at least one must be resident in India.
What is Form 3?
Form 3 files your LLP Agreement with MCA. It must be filed within 30 days of incorporation, or a late fee of ₹100 per day applies.
LLP or Private Limited?
Choose an LLP for lower compliance between partners. Choose a Private Limited if you want to raise investment. See our comparison on the home page.

services.name: One Person Company (OPC) Registration
services.card: Your own company as a single founder, with limited liability.
services.sub: Register a One Person Company with a single owner, a nominee and limited liability.
services.about: A One Person Company lets a single person own a company with limited liability. It has a nominee who takes over in case of the owner's death or incapacity, and it can later convert to a Private Limited Company.
who: Solo founders and freelancers who want a company
Sole proprietors who want limited liability
Founders who may add partners later and convert to Pvt Ltd
get: DSC for the director and the nominee
docs: Of the member and the nominee
Bank statement or electricity bill, not older than 2 months
Of the member and the nominee
We prepare the form for signing
Only if the office is rented
steps: Share two proposed names and your business activity.
DSC is issued and we draft the MOA, AOA and nominee consent.
We file with MCA. Certificate of Incorporation, PAN and TAN are issued.
breakup: DSC for director and nominee (2 × ₹2,000), included
services.pay: Paid in steps. The amount for each step (our fee, govt fee, DSC) is paid just before that step starts.
faq: Can an OPC have more than one owner?
No. An OPC has one member. To add owners, it converts to a Private Limited Company.
Who can be a nominee?
Any Indian resident adult, usually a family member. The nominee gives written consent at registration.

services.name: Startup India (DPIIT) Recognition
services.card: Get your startup recognised by DPIIT under the Startup India scheme.
services.sub: We prepare and file your DPIIT recognition application under Startup India.
facts: For Pvt Ltd, LLP and registered partnerships
services.about: DPIIT recognition certifies your business as a startup under the Government of India's Startup India programme. We handle the DPIIT registration application, including the write-up on your innovation.
who: Private Limited companies, LLPs and registered partnership firms
Entities less than 10 years old from incorporation
Turnover below ₹100 crore in any year
Businesses working on an innovative product, process or service
get: Write-up on your innovation and business
docs: Of the company, LLP or firm
What you do and what is new about it. We help you draft it
Class 3 DSC in the name of the company or LLP, not an individual DSC. We can issue it for ₹2,000
steps: We confirm your entity qualifies for DPIIT recognition.
We prepare the innovation write-up and fill the application.
We file on the Startup India portal and track it till DPIIT decides.
breakup: Organisation DSC (Class 3, 2 years) of the company or LLP, included (an individual DSC does not work)
services.pay: Paid in steps, just before each step starts.
faq: Is DPIIT recognition free from the government?
Yes, the government does not charge a fee for DPIIT recognition.
Do you help with funding?
No. Our service covers DPIIT recognition only.
Which DSC is needed?
An Organisation DSC (Class 3) issued in the name of the company or LLP. A director's or partner's individual DSC cannot be used.

services.name: GST Registration
services.card: Get your GSTIN to bill with GST and claim input tax credit.
services.sub: Get your GST number online, with the right business category and place of business.
facts: GST delivered within 24 hours for startups and small businesses
services.about: GST registration gives your business a GSTIN. It is required once turnover crosses the threshold, for selling on e-commerce platforms, for inter-state supply of goods, and many other cases.
who: Businesses above ₹40 lakh turnover for goods (₹20 lakh for services)
Online sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and others
Businesses supplying goods to other states
Anyone who wants to claim input tax credit
get: HSN and SAC codes for your products or services
docs: Of the business, and of proprietor, partners or directors
Electricity bill, property tax receipt or gas bill; rent agreement if rented
Incorporation certificate, PAN, MOA/AOA, LLP Agreement or partnership deed, as applicable
steps: We check your documents and choose the right category.
We file the application. You complete Aadhaar OTP authentication.
The GST officer verifies and approves. We answer any query raised.
Within 24 hours for startups and small businesses
services.pay: Pay our fee only after your GST certificate is delivered to you.
faq: When do I pay?
Only after your GST certificate (REG-06) is issued and delivered to you.
How long does it take?
For startups and small businesses we deliver GST within 24 hours. If the GST officer raises a query, we reply for you and keep you updated on WhatsApp.
Is there a government fee for GST registration?
No, GST registration is free on the government portal.
Which documents do I need?
It depends on your business type. Open the Documents tab and pick Proprietor, Partnership, LLP or Company to see the exact list.
Can I register from home?
Yes. Your home can be your place of business. Give an electricity bill, property tax receipt or gas bill, plus a consent letter if the home is in a relative's name.
My premises is rented. What do I need?
The rent agreement and the owner's electricity bill, property tax receipt or gas bill, not older than 2 months.
Why does my company or LLP need a separate mobile and email?
GST needs a mobile number and email of the company or LLP itself, different from the directors' or partners'. All GST messages and OTPs go there.
Who must complete Aadhaar authentication?
The proprietor, or the partners or directors, complete Aadhaar OTP authentication on their own mobile. It takes a few minutes.
Do I need a DSC?
Not for a proprietor or partnership firm. Companies and LLPs sign with the director's or partner's DSC.

services.name: GST Return Filing
services.card: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filed on time, monthly or quarterly.
services.sub: One simple price per return, whether you file monthly or quarterly. You send your bills, we do the rest.
services.about: Every GST-registered business must file returns, even with no sales. Late filing attracts late fees, and late tax payment attracts 18% yearly interest. We prepare your tax working, file your returns and remind you before each due date.
who: Every GST-registered business
Quarterly filers under the QRMP scheme
Businesses with nil sales (nil return still needed)
docs: All invoices for the period (up to 30 invoices: bills or photos are fine)
Sales data in Excel (more than 30 invoices)
Invoice no., date, customer GSTIN, state, HSN, quantity, taxable value, CGST, SGST, IGST. Use our Excel format below
Or we set it up with you
steps: Share sales and purchase bills on WhatsApp or email, every month.
We prepare the return and tell you the tax payable.
You pay the tax and we file the return. You get the acknowledgement.
services.pay: Per return, paid before we file. GST tax, late fees or interest, if any, are paid by you to the government.
faq: Does quarterly filing mean I pay tax once a quarter?
No. If you make sales in the 1st or 2nd month of the quarter, the GST on them must be paid by the 25th of the next month (PMT-06). Late payment attracts 18% yearly interest.
What is IFF?
The Invoice Furnishing Facility lets quarterly filers upload B2B bills in months 1 and 2, so their buyers get credit every month. It is optional, at ₹499 per IFF filed.

services.name: GST Filing for E-commerce Sellers
services.card: For sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and other marketplaces.
services.sub: GST returns for online sellers, matched with your marketplace reports and TCS credit.
services.about: Marketplaces deduct TCS and report your sales to GST. Your returns must match their reports. We reconcile your marketplace sales and TCS credit and file accurate returns.
who: Sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, JioMart and similar platforms
Sellers on one platform or many
docs: Monthly tax or GST reports from each platform, in Excel
Your own website or offline sales, in our Excel format if more than 30 invoices
steps: Download your marketplace reports by the 7th (platforms often update data late), or give us view access.
We match sales, returns and TCS across platforms.
You pay the tax and we file GSTR-1 before the 11th, then GSTR-3B. You get the acknowledgement.
services.pay: Per return, paid before we file. Nil return ₹200, one platform ₹499, two or more platforms ₹999. GST tax, if any, is paid by you directly to the government.
faq: What if I had no sales this month?
We file a Nil return for ₹200. Nil returns must still be filed on time, or a late fee applies.
What does selling on multiple platforms mean?

Selling on two or more marketplaces under the same GST number, for example Amazon and Flipkart, or Amazon, Flipkart and Meesho. Each platform sends its own report and TCS, so we reconcile each one. Selling on only one marketplace is ₹499 per return.
Why do you need reports by the 7th?
Marketplaces often update their monthly data late. Reports downloaded by the 7th give us time to reconcile and file GSTR-1 before the 11th.
Do I need GST to sell online?
Yes. Sellers of goods on e-commerce platforms generally need GST registration.

services.name: GST Registration Amendment
services.card: Change address, name, partners, bank or other GST details. See what your change needs.
services.sub: Change details in your GST registration the right way. Tick what you want to change and see the type of change, documents and cost.
facts: Apply within 15 days of the change
services.about: When any detail in your GST registration changes, an amendment must be filed within 15 days of the change. Core field changes need approval from the GST officer. Non-core changes are approved automatically after OTP or DSC verification. Some changes, such as a new PAN or moving to another state, cannot be amended and need a fresh registration.
who: Businesses that moved office within the same state
Firms adding or removing partners or directors
Businesses changing bank account, authorised signatory, email or mobile
Businesses adding goods, services or a new branch
get: Check of which fields can change and how
Amendment application filed on the GST portal
Reply to officer queries, if raised (core changes)
docs: Depends on the field: use the checker above
Authorised signatory OTP, DSC or EVC
To verify the application within 3 days
Or we help you recover it
steps: We confirm whether it is core, non-core or needs a new registration.
We file the application. You complete OTP, DSC or EVC verification within 3 days.
Non-core: approved after verification. Core: approved by the GST officer, who may raise a query.
services.pay: Our fee is paid before we file the application. Core and non-core changes are filed as separate applications.
faq: Can I change my PAN in GST?
No. A new PAN, including a change of constitution like proprietorship to company, needs a fresh GST registration.
I moved to another state. Can I amend?
No. A GSTIN is state-wise. You must apply for a new registration in the new state and cancel the old one.
Can I file a non-core change while a core change is pending?
No. The portal allows a non-core amendment only after the pending core amendment is processed.

services.name: LUT Filing (Export without IGST)
services.card: Export goods or services without paying IGST, by filing your LUT for the year.
services.sub: File your Letter of Undertaking (GST RFD-11) so you can export without paying IGST and avoid waiting for refunds.
services.about: Exporters and suppliers to SEZs can export without paying IGST by filing a Letter of Undertaking (LUT) in Form GST RFD-11. Without an LUT you must pay IGST and then claim a refund. The LUT is valid for one financial year and should be filed before your first export of the year.
who: Exporters of goods
Exporters of services, such as IT, design and consulting
Suppliers to SEZ units and developers
get: LUT (GST RFD-11) filed on the GST portal
LUT acknowledgement (ARN) to quote on export invoices
docs: Name, address and occupation of each
steps: Share witness details and confirm your export activity.
We file RFD-11. You sign with DSC or EVC.
You receive the ARN to quote on your export invoices.
services.pay: Our fee is paid before we file the LUT.
faq: How often do I file the LUT?
Once every financial year, ideally before the first export of that year.
What if I export without an LUT?
You must pay IGST on the export and then claim a refund.

services.name: LLP Annual Compliance
services.card: Form 8 and Form 11 every year, and Form 3 for your LLP Agreement.

facts: Late fee ₹100 per day per form
services.about: Every LLP must file Form 11 (annual return) and Form 8 (statement of accounts and solvency) with MCA every year, even if there was no business. Form 3 files the LLP Agreement and any change to it. Late filing attracts ₹100 per day per form.
who: Every registered LLP, even with zero business
LLPs signing or changing their LLP Agreement
get: Form 11: annual return with partner details
Form 8: statement of accounts and solvency
Form 3: LLP Agreement or its changes
docs: Balance sheet and profit and loss for the year
Any change in partners or contribution

We prepare the forms and share them for review.
Partners sign with DSC and we file. You get the SRN receipts.
services.pay: Paid per form, before we file it: our fee plus the MCA govt fee for that form.
faq: My LLP had no business. Do I still file?
Yes. Form 8 and Form 11 are compulsory every year, even with nil business.
What if I miss the due date?
MCA charges ₹100 per day per form for late filing.

services.name: Private Limited Annual Compliance
services.card: ADT-1, AOC-4 and MGT-7/7A filed on time for your company.
services.sub: Yearly MCA filings for your Private Limited company, filed on time to avoid late fees.
services.about: Every Private Limited company must appoint an auditor (ADT-1) and file its financial statements (AOC-4) and annual return (MGT-7, or MGT-7A for small companies and OPCs) with MCA every year. Late filing attracts ₹100 per day per form.
who: Every Private Limited company, even with zero business
OPCs and small companies (MGT-7A)
New companies appointing their first auditor
docs: With auditor's report and directors' report
steps: Send audited accounts and AGM details.
We prepare ADT-1, AOC-4 and MGT-7/7A for review.
A director signs with DSC and we file. You get the SRN receipts.
services.pay: Paid per form, before we file it: our fee plus the MCA govt fee for that form.
faq: What is ADT-1?
ADT-1 tells MCA who your company's auditor is. It is filed within 15 days of the AGM, and also when an auditor is appointed or changed.
What is MGT-7A?
A shorter annual return for small companies and OPCs.

services.name: Commencement of Business (INC-20A)
services.card: Mandatory declaration within 180 days of incorporation.
services.sub: File the declaration of commencement of business (INC-20A) after the shareholders pay for their shares.
services.about: Every company with share capital incorporated after November 2019 must file INC-20A within 180 days of incorporation, confirming that the subscribers have paid for their shares into the company's bank account. Until it is filed, the company cannot start business or borrow, and late filing attracts a penalty of ₹50,000 on the company and ₹1,000 per day on each director (up to ₹1 lakh), and the ROC can strike the company off.
who: Private Limited companies and OPCs incorporated in the last 180 days
Companies that missed the 180-day deadline (late filing)

INC-20A prepared and certified as needed
docs: Showing share capital received from each subscriber

Filed with MCA, signed with the director's DSC.
breakup: As per capital, ₹200 up to ₹1 lakh
services.pay: Our fee (if any) and the govt fee are paid before we file.
faq: What if I miss 180 days?
The form can still be filed with additional fees, but penalties apply. Contact us quickly.

services.name: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing

services.sub: Accurate ITR filing with the right form, deductions and a check of your AIS and Form 26AS.
services.about: Filing your ITR on time avoids late fees and notices, helps with loans and visas, and lets you claim refunds. We pick the right form, check your income against AIS and Form 26AS, and claim every deduction you're entitled to.

Freelancers and professionals
Small business owners and traders

faq: What is the due date?

I missed the due date. Can I still file?
Yes, a belated return can be filed with a late fee, within the time allowed.

Companies, LLPs and firms deducting TDS on rent, contractors or professionals

Is there a penalty for late filing?
Yes, ₹200 per day under section 234E until the return is filed, up to the TDS amount, plus possible penalty for wrong details.
